home.h1: After a road accident in India
home.intro: Choose what applies to your situation.
home.primarySub: What to do in the first 72 hours
home.secondarySub: I need to understand the claim process
home.asideLine1: Most people reach this page after something has already happened.
home.asideLine2: If you have not, call someone you love today. Say thank you. Say I love you. Do not save it for a better moment.
justHappened.intro: This is a brief orientation. Go to the full checklist for step-by-step guidance on what to do.
disclaimer.text: This site provides general information about the process after a road accident in India. It is not legal advice and it is not a substitute for a lawyer. Rules and contact details change, and details differ by state. Verify anything important with the relevant office or with a lawyer before you act on it. Free legal aid is available through your District Legal Services Authority.
72h.title: What to do in the first 72 hours
72h.intro: Steps are in order. Do not skip ahead. Each one depends on the one before.
72h.shareText: What to do after a road accident in India
docs.title: Documents you need
docs.intro: Start collecting these as soon as the situation allows. Each one serves a specific legal purpose. You are entitled to all of them.
compensation.title: Claiming compensation
compensation.intro: There are two separate routes for compensation after a road accident in India. Both can run in parallel.
mact.title: How compensation is worked out, and what a lawyer can charge
mact.intro: Compensation at MACT is not a negotiation. It is a calculation with fixed steps. If you know roughly what the formula produces for your case, you know whether the number in front of you is fair.
cashless.title: PM-RAHAT: cashless treatment in the Golden Hour
cashless.intro: Road accident victims in India are entitled to cashless emergency treatment at designated hospitals, regardless of who was at fault and regardless of whether the vehicle is insured. The scheme is now called PM-RAHAT; you may still hear it called cashless treatment.
insurance.title: Insurance schemes you may already have
insurance.intro: Several government insurance schemes are linked to ordinary savings bank accounts. Many families do not realise they have coverage until after an accident. Check before assuming there is nothing to claim.
grief.title: Grief and support
grief.intro: This page is for families managing the emotional reality of loss alongside the practical demands of the process.
numbers.title: All helpline numbers
numbers.intro: These numbers work across India. Save them before you need them.
data.title: Road accident figures in India
data.intro: All figures from official government sources. Sources are linked for each item.
updates.title: Recent policy and rights news
updates.intro: Policy news, court rulings, and rights updates from Indian sources. Fetched from GDELT at build time.
about.title: About this site
about.intro: This site helps families in India understand what to do after a road accident. It covers the immediate steps, documents to collect, how to access cashless treatment, and how to claim compensation.
helpNearMe.title: Help near you
helpNearMe.intro: Select your state and district to find your local MACT tribunal and District Legal Services Authority (DLSA).
